+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from _common import load_json_payload, resolve_safe, safe_relative_path, validate_contract
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+
+
+def _load_contracts():
+    contracts = []
+    by_output = {}
+    by_name = {}
+    for path in sorted(ROOT.rglob("contract.json")):
+        if "outputs" in path.relative_to(ROOT).parts:
+            continue
+        contract = validate_contract(load_json_payload(path))
+        if contract["name"] in by_name:
+            raise ValueError("duplicate component name")
+        output = resolve_safe(ROOT, contract["output"])
+        if output in by_output:
+            raise ValueError("duplicate component output")
+        by_name[contract["name"]] = contract
+        by_output[output] = contract
+        contracts.append((path, contract, output))
+    if not contracts:
+        raise ValueError("no contracts")
+    return contracts, by_output
+
+
+def _order_contracts(contracts, by_output):
+    pending = {contract["name"]: item for item in contracts}
+    ordered = []
+    completed = set()
+    while pending:
+        ready = []
+        for name, item in pending.items():
+            dependencies = {by_output[resolve_safe(ROOT, path)] for path in item[1]["inputs"] if resolve_safe(ROOT, path) in by_output}
+            if not dependencies.issubset(completed):
+                continue
+            ready.append(name)
+        if not ready:
+            raise ValueError("component dependency cycle or missing dependency")
+        for name in sorted(ready):
+            ordered.append(pending.pop(name))
+            completed.add(name)
+    return ordered
+
+
+def main():
+    outputs = ROOT / "outputs"
+    if outputs.is_symlink():
+        outputs.unlink()
+    elif outputs.exists():
+        shutil.rmtree(outputs)
+
+    contracts, by_output = _load_contracts()
+    ordered = _order_contracts(contracts, by_output)
+    for contract_path, contract, _ in ordered:
+        subprocess.run(
+            [sys.executable, str(contract_path.with_name("render.py"))],
+            cwd=ROOT,
+            check=True,
+        )
+        expected = resolve_safe(ROOT, contract["output"])
+        if not expected.is_file():
+            raise ValueError(f"component did not create output: {contract['name']}")
+    subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(ROOT / "integrate.py")], cwd=ROOT, check=True)
+    subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(ROOT / "final_report.py")], cwd=ROOT, check=True)
+
